name: Voice Hold
description:
Dictate the macOS way: hold a shortcut (Super+R by default), speak, and the words appear in the text field under your cursor while you talk, block by block. Release to stop; a quick tap toggles hands-free dictation. A dark pill next to the cursor shows the microphone level and the live text.

Everything runs on your computer, offline: French, English and 23 other European languages are recognised with punctuation, no account, no network, no cloud. An optional local LLM (Ollama) can polish the text; it is off by default.

Requires the voice-hold-engine helper (Python, one command to install) and PipeWire. See the project page for the install line.
